message: WEMBLEY PARK STATION: From Monday 10 March until Autumn 2026, no lift service between the street (Wembley Way / car park) and ticket hall. Step-free access is still available by using the entrance/exit on Bridge Road which is level between street and ticket hall. Lifts remain available to all platforms.

Canada Water: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available between the ticket hall and the Jubilee line and southbound Windrush line platforms due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 for further information.

Gospel Oak: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Suffragette line and for eastbound Mildmay line trains due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Liverpool Street: No step free access between the National Rail concourse and the eastbound Circle, Hamm & City and Metropolitan lines due to a faulty lift. Use the Elizabeth line entrance on Broadgate for step free access.

Ealing Broadway: Step free access is not available between the footbridge and platform 4 and the Central and District line platforms due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Bank: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to/from the King William Street entrance due to faulty lifts. For step free access to the DLR and the Northern line, use the entrance on Cannon Street.
Willesden Junction: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Bakerloo line and the Lioness line due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need more information.
Denmark Hill: Step free access is not available to the northbound platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Hackney Wick: No Step Free Access - The lift to the westbound platform is out of service due to a fault. For step free access, use the ramp on Hepscott Road. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

ST PANCRAS INTERNATIONAL STATION: From Monday 15 June until mid September, there will be no step-free access lift available between the ticket hall and THAMESLINK platforms A & B. Please use London Underground connections via Farringdon for step-free access to THAMESLINK, or EAST MIDLANDS RAILWAY services for Luton Airport Parkway and Bedford.

East India: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to/from Nutmeg Lane due to a faulty lift. For step free access, use the entrance on Blackwall Way. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
Camden Road: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the eastbound platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Hackney Downs: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available between Hackney Central and Hackney Downs (platform 1 towards Liverpool Street) due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 for further help.

Highbury & Islington: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Mildmay line platform 8 (trains towards Stratford) due to a faulty lift. Take a train from platform 1 or 2 to Canonbury and change there.

Langley Station: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the westbound platform (towards Reading) and platform 1 due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
Canonbury: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
Brixton: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
West Ham: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the District and Hammersmith & City lines due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

West Brompton: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the northbound Mildmay line / Southern platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Romford: No Step Free Access - The lift to platform 5 (trains towards Shenfield) is out of service. Step free access is available via the ramp only. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Harrow & Wealdstone : No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the northbound London Northwestern / Southern (platforms 4 and 5) due to a faulty lift. Call 0343 222 1234 for help planning your journey.

Wembley Central Station: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the northbound Southern / London Northwestern platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
